name: The Restless Dead
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
narrative.objectives: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah good, its done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
narrative.requestItemsText: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
